value.rationale: The uniform pentagonal prism is a standard canonical noncentrally symmetric polyhedron. Its complete four-point Haar central-section law (including positive heptagon frequency) is a naturally motivated classification; the full positive aspect family and sharply different thin/tall asymptotics distinguish geometric behavior not implied by an expected face count, a width moment, or enumerating possible section polygons. Applicable as an exact stereological angular benchmark.
